integrity: The radius is derived from the published halfspace description by permutation symmetrization, exact normalized facet distances, an endpoint minimization proved by a one-sign-change derivative, and active-facet uniqueness. Full texts on the same object and a broader generalized parking-function family were compared; a residual risk remains of a differently worded general Chebyshev-center theorem specializing to the same formula.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to m>=2 and n>=m-1 and to the standard Euclidean norm. It does not compute inradii in the more redundant regime n<m-1, John ellipsoids, circumradii, or non-Euclidean radii. Finite verification is only a cross-check of the analytic proof.
title: Exact Euclidean inradius of partial permutohedra
